pages.title: Carborane Superacid
pages.text: The strongest acid that can be bottled. It protonates almost anything yet is gentle on glass, because its conjugate base is so stable it does not attack. It is clear and calm in the flask. It is one of the few acids that is strong and polite at the same time.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Carborane acids are a million times stronger than sulfuric. Electrolysing an Electride Crystal with chiral crystal and ionic liquid, I made one strong enough to protonate anything.
